phase_classes_physical_merges.why: the most Cu-rich compound, AuBe5-type (C15b, cF24) in both: Hallstedt 2025 mmc2 lists CU9ZR2_C15B as AuBe5 cF24 and CU5ZR_C15B is C15b by name; the assessments disagree on its stoichiometry (Cu5Zr x=0.167 vs Cu9Zr2 x=0.182), not on the phase. The registry keeps them apart (assessment_declared_blocked_by:stoichiometry_contradicts_C15_b).

CuZr2 (MoSi2-type tI6 in the registry) and the high/low-temperature variants of Wang 2006 and the handbook (αCuZr2 / βCuZr2): one composition, polymorph family (registry CONFLICTS: polymorph_family). Models carry one CuZr2.
B2 (CsCl) CuZr, modelled stoichiometrically (CUZR_B2) or as the ordered part of a BCC order/disorder model (B2_BCC, 22Zho; only when ordered, see ORDER_TOL).
